blind.B1: No. The study is hindlimb unloading (disuse) for 8/14 wk and 8 wk reloading in mice (S4.1.p1); there is no exercise or training arm. Reloading (HUR) is recovery from disuse, not exercise. All 10 libraries are SSC/MSC from bone marrow, none carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: 8wk HU vs AMB in SSC and in MSC (S2.4.p1: 3991 and 1504 DEGs); 14wk HU vs AMB in SSC and MSC (S2.5.p2, counts only in Suppl. Fig. 5d,e); HUR vs AMB in SSC (S2.6.p2, clustering only). Each group is one pooled RNA library (3-4 mice), so n=1 per group (S4.7.p1; S2.4.p1 'pooled BM N=3 mice').
blind.B3: No animal is sampled twice; each library is a pool of different mice, and SSC and MSC were prepared from separate cohorts (S2.4.p1 'a separate cohort of mice'). The packet key grp (links SSC and MSC of the same group) is a label combination, not an animal, and the expression check says not_supported.
blind.B4: Paper fitted each two-group comparison alone with edgeR exact test, dispersion fixed at 0.2 (S4.8.p1: 'A dispersion value of 0.2 was used for differential expression exact test analysis'). No joint model.
blind.B5: No explicit DEG rule for RNA-seq in S4.8.p1. General 'Significance level was set at p <= 0.05, unless otherwise indicated' (S4.9.p1); Fig. 3c legend highlights Log2 FC > 2; GO terms p < 0.005. Counts: 3991 DEGs (SSC) and 1504 (MSC), 8wk HU vs AMB (S2.4.p1).

checks.evidence: S4.1.p1: HU/AMB/HUR only; no exercise arm. The exercise-word flag fires on 'unloaded' in titles, a false positive.
Refused before contrasts ran; grp levels match the paper's groups (one library each).
No contrast executed; planned HU (treatment) vs AMB (control) is the paper's direction.
Pools of different mice, SSC and MSC from separate cohorts (S2.4.p1); expression check not_supported; repeated_measure_unit recorded as none.
Not run. Paper's pairwise fixed-dispersion edgeR recorded in paper_reconstruction (S4.8.p1).
Record notes the 14wk MSC total-RNA prep vs poly-A for the others (S4.7.p1); single-housing applies to both AMB and HU (S4.1.p1).
Integer fraction 1.0, featureCounts raw counts, 95883 ENSMUST x 10; edgeR recommended.
Paper states no DEG rule; record uses p<0.05 with stated_explicitly=false (S4.9.p1), matching my B5.
HANDBACK lists ours as not run against 3991/1504 and makes no claim of reproduction.

'No exercise arm' true (S4.1.p1). 'n=1 vs 1' true: 10 libraries, one per cell type x treatment x duration, packet A level counts and S4.7.p1 pooling; suitability 0/21 comparisons with >=3 per group. Both claims checked against the full sample table, not one column.

summary: 该系列是后肢卸载（废用）及复负重，没有运动或训练组，且每组仅为一个由3-4只小鼠合并的文库（n=1 vs 1），拒绝分析的两条理由都成立。配对候选键grp只是标签组合，表达检验不支持，不构成动物ID。判定通过，无需修改。
